name: Shenmao Technology Inc
summary: Shenmao Technology Inc, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells solder materials in the Taiwan, Mainland China, Thailand, Malaysia, and internationally. The company offers SMT assembly materials, including tin lead, lead-free, water soluble, package on package, low temperature, and halogen free solder pastes, as well as adhesives; and semiconductor packaging products, such as BGA spheres and bumping solder pastes.
